content.text: Digital creators in regions with limited payment options face a significant infrastructure challenge. Without reliable platforms like Stripe or PayPal, establishing a digital store can seem impossible. COREMERCH provides a solution through Stack 01, utilizing GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-what-actually-how-13|COREMERCH guide to payments]], enabling seamless crypto transactions. This guide will walk you through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-first-principles-7|Cloudflare R2]]-pages-free-step-step-30|deploying]] Supabase as your order database for a fully operational online store, ensuring you have ownership and control over your infrastructure.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms often impose restrictions that can hinder digital creators, especially in developing countries. COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed to overcome these barriers by offering tools that function independently of restrictive payment processors. With our systems, you retain complete ownership of your digital store and its data, ensuring that you're not at the mercy of a platform's rules or limitations. This autonomy allows you to focus on your creative work without the constant worry of payment rejections or account freezes.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store with Supabase as your order database, ensure you have the necessary components. You will need a GitHub account for hosting your store, a Google account to leverage Apps Script, and a NOWPayments account to process crypto payments. Familiarize yourself with Supabase, which will serve as your backend database for orders. Have your digital products ready in a deliverable format, and ensure you understand the payment process to facilitate smooth transactions once your store goes live.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment layer using NOWPayments to facilitate crypto transactions. This step involves integrating the payment process into your Apps Script, ensuring that transactions are verified on-chain. Next, set up Supabase as your order database, where all transactions will be recorded. Utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant delivery of your digital products. Once the payment is confirmed, an automatic webhook will ensure that the product is delivered seamlessly. This setup guarantees that you have a reliable delivery system in place.
No restrictions: Own your digital store without platform limitations.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is configured, it's time to go live. Deploy your GitHub Pages site, and run a final test transaction to ensure everything is functioning correctly. Monitor the process from payment initiation to product delivery, verifying that each step occurs without issues. Once you successfully complete your first transaction, you can confidently promote your digital store, knowing that your infrastructure is robust and ready for business.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After launching your digital store, focus on scaling it effectively. With Supabase handling your order database, you can easily manage an increasing number of transactions. Consider adding more digital products, and utilize the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced capabilities. This stack provides essential features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for improved email deliverability and security. Regularly analyze your sales data to understand customer preferences and adapt your offerings accordingly.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize COREMERCH's infrastructure. Start with Stack 01, which involves deploying GitHub Pages for hosting, integrating Apps Script for backend logic, and using NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows you to build an independent store without relying on conventional platforms.
Fast deployment: Stack 01 can be set up in just 4-6 hours.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Each platform offers unique advantages, with GitHub Pages being ideal for Stack 01 and Cloudflare Pages providing enhanced performance and scalability for Stack 02.
What type of products can I sell using this infrastructure?

You can sell a variety of digital products using this infrastructure, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. This flexibility allows you to cater to different market needs and expand your offerings.
How does payment processing work with NOWPayments?

Payment processing with NOWPayments is straightforward. Customers can pay using over 300 cryptocurrencies, and the platform charges a minimal 0.5% fee. Transactions are confirmed on-chain, ensuring reliability and security for both you and your customers.
